conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Officer Gregory Walters with the Internal Revenue Service, Badge ID 72918. Can you confirm you are speaking with Mr. Ajay Patel?
Yes, this is Ajay Patel. Is something wrong?

Mr. Patel, we are contacting you regarding urgent discrepancies found in your federal tax filings for the past three years. The IRS has opened Case File 50213A. Are you aware of any issues with your taxes?
No, I am not. I just did my taxes with a software. What is the problem?

According to our records, there is a significant underreporting of your taxable income, totaling $4,890.27. This has triggered a legal review and, as of this morning, a warrant for your arrest was issued by the Federal District Court.
Wait, a warrant? Arrest? I don't understand, I paid everything I was told to.
Mr. Patel, failure to resolve IRS debt is a federal offense. Under U.S. law, this may result in immediate arrest, asset freeze, and potential deportation if not settled without delay.
This is very scary. What am I supposed to do now?
Let me verify some details. Can you please confirm your current mailing address and the last four digits of your Social Security Number for identification purposes?
My address is 254 Lakeview Ave, Apt 7B, and the last four are 9923.

Thank you for confirming. I see the warrant is active and scheduled for enforcement within the next 90 minutes. However, as a courtesy, the IRS allows taxpayers to resolve such matters outside of court by making an immediate payment through our secure system.
I don't want any trouble. What do I need to do?

To halt further action, you must submit the outstanding balance right away. Due to the urgency, payments can only be accepted through Bitcoin or Apple Store gift cards. Which method is more convenient for you?
I don't have Bitcoin. I can maybe buy gift cards.

That will work. Please go to a nearby Walmart, Target, or Apple Store and purchase $4,900 in Apple Store gift cards. You must not disclose the reason for your purchase to store staff, as this is a confidential federal matter.
Okay, I think there is a Walmart about 10 minutes away. Should I go now?

Yes, proceed immediately. Remain on the line with me while you travel. Once you have purchased the cards, I will instruct you on how to provide the codes so we can process your payment and cancel the warrant.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I just want to make sure I don't get in trouble.
As long as you follow my instructions, the arrest warrant will be suspended. Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back so I can enter them into the IRS payment portal.
Okay, I will call you as soon as I have them.
Stay on the line. If you disconnect or delay, law enforcement may proceed with the case. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I will stay on the line.
Very good. Once you have the gift cards, confirm the total amount and read each code to me carefully. We must input them without error.
Okay, I am almost at the store now.
